inputs.declared_question: Which dependencies and context must travel inside a generative plate for independent reconstruction after the first venue disappears?

sources_checked.title: Field Note 33: The Plate and the Pull

source_facts.claim: The WACZ 1.2.0 draft packages recorded web resources, indexes, entry pages, context, and file fixity in a portable ZIP, with selective browser replay through HTTP range requests.
The document expressly says it is a draft with no official standards standing or consensus and does not require a signature or prescribe a trust model.
Field Note 33 describes a public algorithm, an authorized lineage of pulls, and a browser encounter that should survive a sole service.
source_facts.locator: The browser can perform the encounter on the visitor's own machine

cartographer.inference: WACZ remains a possible packaging precedent for carrying browser-readable context and verifiable resources, but its captured HTTP replay is not an executable generative plate or an edition authority.
cartographer.uncertainty: Draft status and optional signing limit what can be borrowed as settled preservation or authenticity practice. WACZ alone cannot establish a generative work's execution, intended rendering, authorized pull lineage, or verifiable end.
cartographer.attribution: External facts come only from the official Webrecorder public specification and repository. No external person or organization was contacted, and no private material was read.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The current draft supports the existing proposed node and cautious technical adjacency, including the previously recorded status and trust qualifications. A new candidate would duplicate the queue.

decisions.decision: Replace both non-existent heading locators on REL-000004 with distinctive passages present in the exact A-001 and FN-33 sources.
Keep the context relation strong, active, and visibly proposed. The source passages support its existing rationale; this correction does not strengthen or ratify its interpretation.
Publish a dated tending record because the relational evidence changed, but do not rotate the still-relevant three-item Attending arrangement.

evidence.locator: Where most digital systems ask people to trust the platform
Cyberdelic.space already approaches publication this way.

gardener.decision_reason: The prior REL-000004 locators named headings absent from both exact publications. The revised passages make the already supported relation inspectable without altering its endpoints, type, confidence, lifecycle, or review state.

decisions.decision: Retain the FN-33 and WACZ records. Their summaries, search terms, questions, evidence, and visibly proposed relation remain grounded in the exact note and the provisional public draft.
Keep directory results bounded to six and the default Library aperture at three works.

librarian.no_change_reason: The manifest evidence correction does not create a new ordinary-language finding path or make an existing catalog record inaccurate.

checks.result: The official WACZ 1.2.0 draft and maintained Webrecorder source were accessible and supported the portable-package facts, explicit draft status, optional signing, and open trust boundary without conflict.
All 41 JSON documents and three XML documents parsed successfully.
All 31 indexed Field, Workshop, and Library sources matched recorded byte lengths and SHA-256 values. Both new REL-000004 evidence locators occur in their exact A-001 and FN-33 sources.
All 2,850 local links and assets resolved across 137 HTML pages.

All eight JavaScript files passed syntax checks. The 18 proposals, 15 catalog records, twelve relational nodes, seven edges, unique identifiers, required catalog fields, and finite limits passed contract checks.

The new dated record, Living Relationships, and the homepage directory rendered at 390 by 844 pixels with the psychedelic default, accessible links and search, and no horizontal overflow; document width equalled viewport width.
A homepage search for WACZ returned two visibly model-proposed paths within the six-result limit. The three-work default Library aperture remained unchanged.
The current Attending arrangement remained exactly three items and was not rotated for an evidence correction.
No em dash characters were added.

Only the relational manifest, dated audit, relationship pages, one permitted relations sitemap URL, and deterministic mirror changed. No exact publication, application, ratification record, or human-locked control changed.
The deterministic mirror was rebuilt twice with identical SHA-256 output, includes the dated audit and record, and matches every archived source byte for byte.

unresolved_questions: Which resources must travel with a generative plate rather than remaining replaceable properties of its reader?
What independent evidence can prove authorized edition lineage beyond package fixity?
note: The new public dated record explains one material relational evidence correction. Attending remains finite and unchanged; prior proposal and audit history remains available.
